subject: Engagement outline & approval lifecycle — Quasar.ai evaluation
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rebecca Li <rebecca@quasar.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement outline & approval lifecycle — Quasar.ai evaluation

Hi Rebecca —

Great speaking with you and the product team earlier. Quick note to capture what we heard and propose a lightweight engagement outline so your stakeholders can see a clear approval path. High-level summary: 

- Primary pain: inconsistent LLM latency and high per-token cost on customer-facing workflows, esp. recommendations and search rescoring.
- Primary goal: reduce tail latency to <200ms for 95th percentile and cut per-token cost by ~40% without noticeable quality regression.
- Constraints: must pass SOC 2 evidence review and be deployable inside your VPC for PII-adjacent workloads.

Proposed engagement outline (short timeline for exec/finance review):
1) Technical discovery & sample workloads (1 week) — feasibility and perf baseline. Owners: Quasar Eng (Rebecca), Redwood AE (Logan).
2) Proof-of-concept (4 weeks) — dedicated pilot capacity with representative traffic, prefix caching enabled. Stakeholders: Eng, Platform, Security.
3) Exec review & cost approval (2 weeks) — procurement and finance review TCO.
4) Pilot to production ramp (6–8 weeks) — rollout + SLA handover.

Key decision owners we need to confirm:
- Procurement/Finance owner (who signs)
- Security owner for SOC 2 packet review
- Technical sponsor for trial sign-off

As next steps, can you confirm the names/emails for procurement and security? Ill attach a one-page TCO model and the security questionnaire for your InfoSec team to review. If that looks good well propose kickoff dates and provide short access to a sandbox tenant.

Attaching: Quasar-Prelim-TCO.xlsx (tco assumptions) and the security questionnaire (to be filled by Quasar).

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
log a n.wright@redwood-inference.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Rebecca Li <rebecca@quasar.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@quasar.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement outline & approval lifecycle — Quasar.ai evaluation

Thanks Logan —

This accurately reflects the call. A few clarifications from our side:
- Procurement owner: Tom Harris (ccd). Finance will want an exec summary plus the 12-month TCO line items.
- Security: Ill route the questionnaire to our InfoSec (lead is Priya K.). They will want evidence of encryption in transit + key management options.
- Timeline: were targeting a vendor decision by the end of August to align with next quarter budget planning. That means the PoC needs to start by mid-July if possible.

I filled in a few fields in the attached questionnaire and added an initial comment about HSM/KMS preferences. I attached the updated PDF: Quasar-Security-Questionnaire.pdf.

Quick ask: can you provide an abbreviated one-page exec summary (1/2 page) that highlights expected latency improvement, unit-cost delta, and any SLA commitments we can reference in the procurement packet? Also please confirm who on your side will be our technical lead for the PoC (so I can invite them to the kickoff).

Onward —
Rebecca Li
Head of Product, Quasar.ai
rebecca@quasar.ai | +1 617-555-0987

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rebecca Li <rebecca@quasar.ai>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@quasar.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement outline & approval lifecycle — Quasar.ai evaluation

Rebecca / Tom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per your asks Ive attached: 1) a one-page exec summary that highlights the perf & cost delta, 2) an editable TCO workbook (same as earlier), and 3) the blank security questionnaire filled with pointers where InfoSec typically requests logs/evidence.

Exec summary key bullets (for copy into procurement packet):
- Expected 95th pctl latency improvement: from ~600ms to <200ms on medium-length sequences (based on similar retail & search workloads).
- Typical per-token unit cost reduction: 30–50% depending on batching and KV-cache hit rates (we'll baseline during discovery).
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for dedicated pools; per-request latency SLOs configurable for dedicated deployments.
- Data controls: VPC/private deployment available; KMS/HSM integrations supported for key management; audit logs exportable to your SIEM.

Proposed kickoff window:
- Week of Jul 17: tech kickoff + dataset handoff (1 week discovery).
- Week of Jul 24: PoC live (4-week run) with weekly syncs and pre-specified success metrics.
- Week of Aug 21: Procurement/Finance review & decision.

PoC owners (Redwood):
- Technical lead: Karthik Iyer (Platform & Serving runtime)
- Customer success: Monica Patel (pilot enablement)

PoC owners (Quasar):
- Product: Rebecca Li
- Procurement/Finance: Tom Harris
- Security reviewer: Priya K. (InfoSec)

Please confirm procurement & security contacts and whether the Jul 17 kickoff works. If approved, Ill send a short calendar invite with a proposed agenda and prep checklist.

Best,
Logan

---
Attachments: Quasar-Exec-Summary-1p.pdf; Quasar-Prelim-TCO.xlsx; Quasar-Security-Questionnaire.pdf

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@quasar.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>, Rebecca Li <rebecca@quasar.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jul 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement outline & approval lifecycle — Quasar.ai evaluation

Logan / Rebecca —

Thanks for the materials. Quick notes from procurement & finance:
- We like the 3-phase approach. Finance needs the TCO populated with our expected traffic numbers (Ill have our analyst update the TCO sheet this week).
- Procurement requests an abbreviated vendor terms summary (lead time for infra, cancellation terms for trial, indemnity overview). Can you provide a short summary doc?
- Security: Priya will review the questionnaire next Tues; she may follow up with a short walkthrough call.

On approvals: our internal approval window is the week of Aug 21–25. If you can start the PoC on Jul 24 instead of Jul 17, we can still make that window work (well just tighten the discovery to 3 business days). Can Karthik confirm that Jul 24 start is acceptable?

Also, could someone on the Redwood infra team join a 30-min technical deep-dive with our platform engineers next Wed (Jul 20) at 10am ET? Ill send a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

Thanks —
Tom Harris
Director, Procurement & Vendor Ops, Quasar.ai
+1 212-555-0077
